title: ID Photo Generator WordPress Plugin
summary: A custom WordPress plugin for automated ID photo generation using third-party API integration, real-time processing and validation.
challenge: Users needed a simpler way to upload images and receive correctly formatted ID photos without manual processing.
solution: Built a custom WordPress plugin for ID photo generation.
Added upload, real-time processing and validation workflows.
outcomes: Reduced manual effort for ID photo preparation.
Created a scalable API-integrated WordPress solution.
